text:
ash: Quick idea — Thurs after work? Tapas place by the plaza (small plates) + 20-min pub-style trivia + a tiny plant-swap (cuttings or small pots only). Low-key, meet ~6:30pm. Who's up? :shallow_pan_of_food: :seedling:

kevin: I'm in. Can bring a short trivia pack and tapas recs. :trophy:

sara: love it. GF options please if possible — also i swap seeds instead of pots (apt is tiny).

maddie: count me in. i'll MC trivia for 15m and bring a tiny ceramic prize. also can bring extra napkins. :sparkles:

ops-bot: FYI: team socials under $15/person are eligible for "team-social" expense. Submit receipts and attendee list at https://redwood.internal/expenses. Approval typically 24-48h.

ash: doing a 1Q poll via reactions: :one: = Thurs 6:30, :two: = Fri 6:30, :x: = can't make it. react please.

kevin: :one:

sara: :one:

maddie: :one:

lee-remote: :house: i'll be remote but will drop in on Zoom for the trivia and plant show-and-tell.

ash: OK Thurs wins. i'll create a calendar invite and reserve a small table. i'll ask venue to set aside a GF tapas plate for @sara and note vegan options. i'll DM People Ops about a $10/head voucher for trivia winners.

maddie: bringing the ceramic pot prize  please no muddy swaps on the table (use small zip bags).

sara: thx! happy to swap seeds with someone who wants a basil starter. :herb:

ash: remote folks — we'll stream the trivia and post questions in-thread so you can shout answers. also tagging @events or ops-bot if anyone wants a stipend.

ops-bot: Reminder: if you plan to expense vouchers, attach receipts and attendee list and tag #lunch-plans.

ash: sweet. i'll pin the invite + address here when booked. tag anyone else who'd dig tapas + plants. See you Thurs 6:30! :raised_hands:
